content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Alpharetta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's education and experience prerequisites to confirm you meet the credential's baseline requirements before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. All instruction is delivered online by active certified practitioners, enabling you to earn the required contact hours on a schedule that fits your Alpharetta-area role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process to ensure your application is complete and approved promptly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and review sessions, to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the assessment at a location convenient to you.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle to maintain your credential. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer numerous pathways—including workshops, courses, and self-directed learning—to help you sustain your certification.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
